description: This file defines a React functional component 'SettingsModal' for a note-taking web application. It manages user settings such as themes, editor options, data import/export, and account management via a modal dialog with various tabs.

methods.name: handleDomClick
methods.description: Handles click events outside the modal to close it.

methods.name: toggleDarkThemeHandler
methods.description: Toggles dark theme and updates the editor theme accordingly.

methods.name: toggleLineHighlight
methods.description: Toggles code editor's active line highlighting.

methods.name: toggleScrollPastEnd
methods.description: Toggles the scroll past end option in the editor.

methods.name: toggleLineNumbersHandler
methods.description: Toggles display of line numbers in the editor.

methods.name: handleEscPress
methods.description: Handles pressing the Escape key to close the modal.

methods.name: updateNotesDirectionHandler
methods.description: Updates the text direction for notes.

methods.name: downloadNotesHandler
methods.description: Handles downloading notes as Markdown files.

methods.name: backupHandler
methods.description: Handles backing up notes as JSON.

methods.name: importBackupHandler
methods.description: Imports notes and categories from a JSON file.
